thread:
maria: Heads up — noticed cost attribution for v1->v2 fallback routing shows up under 'unattributed' in billing dashboard. Can we map those tokens to origin model + fallback reason? Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/s/abc123
eric: yeah saw that. Looks like our proxy sets `X-Redwood-Route: fallback` but drops `X-Orig-Model` when we rewrite. quick fix is to preserve `X-Orig-Model` but we also need telemetry schema change.
jin: agreed. we should emit event: `routing.fallback` with fields {origin_model, target_model, reason, cost_tokens, latency_ms}. sampling 1% by default to limit cardinality.
maria: 1% ok. But need console to surface it: dropdown in model metrics 'include fallbacks' + checkbox 'map to origin model'
lia: note: customers on Dedicated care about exact token attribution. we should allow per-tenant opt-in full telemetry (no sampling) behind enterprise flag.
eric: ops-bot: deploy plan? we need to change proxy header passthrough, runtime telemetry schema, and console toggle. Rolling deploy, canary 5% tenants, backfill for last 48h not possible.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: new commit deployed to canary cluster 2026-03-18T21:12:00Z. Watch routing.fallback metric in grafana: /d/routing/fallbacks
jin: UX note: avoid creating a new top-level metric. reuse existing `token.cost.breakdown` with dimension `fallback_reason` so dashboard queries stay simple.
maria: good call. also add alert: if fallback token ratio > 5% and cost delta > 10% for >1h, page eng-platform oncall.
eric: I'll open PR for proxy change and telemetry event schema. Lia, can you draft tenant opt-in flag text for Console? sample language: 'Include routed fallback tokens in model billing and metrics'
lia: on it. will also add tooltip: 'Attribution will change historical aggregates when enabled for a tenant.'
maria: :thumbsup: timeline? canary + metrics visible in console in 2 weeks?
eric: target two weeks. sample rate default 0.01, enterprise opt-in documented.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary successful for 3 days, no spike. rolling to 25% tomorrow.
